title: Results split across messages
task: Read the six notes in notes/ and write a one-line summary to notes/summary.txt.
system: You are a coding agent. Use the tools you are given. Say done when the summary is written.

script.say: I'll read the first three notes together.

then.say: I'll read the next note on its own.

else.say: I'll read the next three notes together.

then.say: I'll read the next note on its own.

else.say: I have all six notes. I'll write the summary.

tools.content: Six notes: milk, Sam, room, bread, car and trip.

then.say: I'll read the last note on its own.
I have all six notes. I'll write the summary.

tools.content: Six notes: milk, Sam, room, bread, car and trip.

incident.why: The model asked for the notes in one reply. The harness handed back each result in its own user message: event 7 is the first, and 9 and 11 are the other two from the same reply. The next request then held several user messages in a row, and the model read one note per turn. The run took more turns than it needed to.
incident.hint: Count the user messages the harness sends back after the model's first reply. Then look at what the model does on the next turn.

notes.text: This is the first request with user messages in a row. The model's next reply reacts to it.
The model is not broken. It reads one note per turn because the history now looks like one message per result.

fixes.text: Send all the results of one reply back together, in one user message
fixes.why: The docs say one tool_result per tool_use, all in the next user message. Then the history has the shape the model expects, and it can read in parallel.

fixes.text: Tell the model in the prompt to read the notes in one call
fixes.why: Tempting, but the model's first reply already asked for all three in one call. The harness split the results after that, so the prompt is not the bug.

fixes.text: Give the run a higher turn limit
fixes.why: Tempting, but nothing ran out. The run ended as done after six turns, and it passed.
